summary: You can now share the GitHub Copilot plugins your team relies on without asking every member to repeat the same setup. Team customizations are generally available for organization teams.
takeaways: Set up plugins for a team If you’re a team maintainer or organization owner, open your organization team on github.com and select the Customize Copilot tab.
From there, you can: Browse plugins from the marketplaces built into Copilot, your enterprise’s marketplaces, and any marketplaces the team adds.
Add a marketplace from a GitHub repository that contains a plugin marketplace.
